conceptDrafts.logline: A debt-collection caller who is the agency's best closer keeps dialing one delinquent account after hours — because the woman who owes $312 talks to her like a daughter, and the account holder died eight months ago.

concept.summary: Mackenzie 'Mac' Torres clears more delinquent accounts than anyone on the floor by never breaking script. Except after close, when she dials account #40-1187 — Louise Prewitt, $312 past due on a hospital bed rental — and lets the old woman talk her through recipes and bad marriages and what Mac should do with her life. The agency's new audit software flags the after-hours calls the same week Mac learns the account was written off because Louise Prewitt died in March. Someone on the line has been keeping Louise alive for her — and Mac keeps calling anyway.

characters.name: Mac Torres
characters.backstory: Aged out of foster care into a headset; the script gave her a voice that never shakes.
characters.motivations: Keep the one call where somebody asks about HER day.
characters.flaws: Can only accept care when it arrives through a script she controls.
characters.need: One relationship with no account number attached.

relationships.description: delinquent account #40-1187 turned surrogate mother — a voice Mac has never met

characters.voice: compliance-script cadence that slips into softness after 6pm
characters.arc: From closing accounts to leaving one open on purpose.

characters.name: Louise Prewitt (the voice)
characters.backstory: Account holder, $312 past due, deceased in March — and yet the Tuesday calls connect.
characters.want: Mac to eat something green and quit that job.

relationships.description: calls her 'the girl' — knows Mac's schedule better than Mac's manager does

characters.voice: kitchen-radio warmth; changes subject when the line crackles

beats.name: Best Closer
beats.summary: Mac closes three brutal collection calls back-to-back without leaving script, wins the floor's monthly plaque, and stays after close to dial a number she knows by heart.
beats.purpose: Establish the script as Mac's armor — so its after-hours softening reads as intimacy, not sloppiness.

beats.name: Account Closed
beats.summary: Mid-call with Louise about Sunday gravy, the audit software force-closes account #40-1187 on Mac's screen with the flag DECEASED 03/14 — while Louise is still talking.
beats.purpose: The audience learns Louise is dead WHILE hearing her voice — the reveal must land through the screen, not through Mac saying it.

beats.name: Redial
beats.summary: Alone in the parking garage, Mac redials the closed account against every policy she's ever enforced; the line connects on the seventh ring.
beats.purpose: Mac chooses the impossible call over the rules that made her — the closer leaves an account open.

snippets.title: The gravy correction
snippets.content: Louise: 'You brown the neck bones FIRST, Mackenzie. Anyone who tells you the onions go first was raised by wolves. Now — you sound tired. Did that manager make you cry again or did you let him think he did?'
